All 7 audits complete + documentation. Final summary:

**QA Run 30 — UI consistency audit results**

Walked all 19 authenticated pages with Playwright + read every component file.

| Audit | Result |
|---|---|
| 1. Icons | PASS — 100% Heroicons outline; the 9 non-Heroicon SVGs on /reports are Recharts chart legend/wrapper elements (not icons) |
| 2. Buttons | PASS — primary CTAs (`auth-btn`), secondary actions (`quick-action-btn`), filter selects, and pill toggles all consistent across pages |
| 3. Headers | PASS — every page measures headerH=56px exactly |
| 4. Sidebar | PASS — identical nav buttons everywhere (h=42, br=12px, fs=13.5px) |
| 5. Form elements | PASS — 0 native `<select>`, 0 native `<input type="date">`; all standard inputs use `.form-input` |
| 6. Spacing | PASS — H1 18px/700 on every page; stat-card gap 16px consistent |
| 7. **Modals — 2 bugs fixed** | `ImportLeadsModal.jsx:166` and `DripSequences.jsx:572` both used `className="modal-backdrop"` without the required inline `position/inset/background/blur` styles. The `.modal-backdrop` CSS class only carries the animation — every other modal in the app sets the visual overlay inline. Both modals rendered with a transparent, click-through backdrop. Fixed with the standard pattern used by 14 other modals. |

**Commit:** `87d7230 fix(ui): restore backdrop styling on ImportLeads + DripSequences delete modals`
**Build:** clean (`vite build` passed after fix)
**Verification:** Playwright re-tested the Import modal after fix — backdrop now `oklch(0 0 0 / 0.6)`, position fixed, full viewport, 8px blur
**Deliverable:** `/c/Projects/stormleads/ui-audit-results.txt` + updated `overnight_resume.md` for next run
